definitions.gloss: delayed departure; a departure that is behind schedule
definitions.explanation: A departure (of a train, bus, airplane, or ship) that is delayed beyond its scheduled time. Used primarily in transportation contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{延発|えんぱつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The train had a delayed departure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪天候|あくてんこう}→悪天候：16184_akutenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延発|えんぱつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to bad weather, the plane had a one-hour delay in departure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延発|えんぱつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}え→乗り換え：16130_norikae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{接続|せつぞく}→接続：04367_setsuzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れなく→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Due to the Shinkansen's delayed departure, I was unable to make my transfer connection.

notes:
{延|えん} means delayed/extended and {発|ぱつ} means departure. Used in transportation announcements and reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {延発|えんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to depart late
- {延発|えんぱつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to result in a delayed departure
- ～{分|ぷん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延発|えんぱつ}: a delay of ~ minutes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遅延|ちえん}→遅延：06749_chien⟧: delay in general (broader term, includes delays during travel)
- {遅発|ちはつ}: late departure (less common)
- ⟦{定刻|ていこく}→定刻：16982_teikoku⟧{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}する→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧: to depart on time (the positive counterpart)
